fullDesc: In 480 BC a small Greek force led by King Leonidas of Sparta held the narrow pass at Thermopylae against the vast Persian army of Xerxes for three days. They were finally outflanked, but the stand became a symbol of courage.
realFacts: About 300 Spartans fought beside several thousand other Greeks
A local traitor showed the Persians a path around the pass
Greece went on to win at Salamis and Plataea
